item.title: Togakushi Shrine: A Sacred Mountain Shrine and Towering Cedar Avenue — Guide
item.description: Togakushi Shrine is a sacred mountain shrine complex set deep in the forested mountains north of Nagano City, comprising three main shrines (the lower, middle and upper) connected by walking trails and steeped in centuries of mountain-worship and shugendo ascetic tradition. Its most famous feature is the approach to the Okusha inner shrine, a roughly two-kilometre forest path lined for its final stretch with towering ancient cedar trees, some over 400 years old, creating one of the most atmospheric shrine approaches in Japan; the area is also historically linked to the Togakure school of ninja.
